solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ NOT C '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced: CHARS '#' [ 'C' BIND 'K' BIND K CHARS -1 DROP JOIN K C 2 COLLECT JOIN K CHARS -1 GET '(' '[' '?' C ']' EQ SELECT C ')' EQ SELECT EQ SELECT ] FOLD '#' EQ
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS '#' [ 'C' BIND 'K' BIND K CHARS -1 DROP JOIN K C 2 COLLECT JOIN K CHARS -1 GET '(' '[' '?' C ']' EQ SELECT C ')' EQ SELECT EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'ST' BIND ST 0 [ 'Q' BIND 1 ADD ] SCAN [ 'I' BIND I 0 ST I 1 SUB GET '#' EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.unmatched: CHARS '#' [ 'C' BIND 'K' BIND K CHARS -1 DROP JOIN K C 2 COLLECT JOIN K CHARS -1 GET '(' '[' '?' C ']' EQ SELECT C ')' EQ SELECT EQ SELECT ] FOLD CHARS LENGTH 1 SUB
solutions.ledger.by_name: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
solutions.ledger.top_name: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS 'K' BIND G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 'V' BIND K V -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS 'K' BIND G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 'V' BIND K V 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.normalize: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.messy.distinct: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER UNIQUE LENGTH
solutions.messy.top_word: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER [ LOWER CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER UNIQUE SORT [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.prose.longest: ' ' TOKENIZE 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: ' ' TOKENIZE TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.distinct_sorted: ' ' TOKENIZE UNIQUE SORT [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.prose.reverse_words: ' ' TOKENIZE REVERSE [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.prose.capitalize: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS 1 DROP JOIN
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: [ [ 1/2 0 ] ] [ 'X' BIND 'R' BIND R -1 GET 'LP' BIND R R LENGTH 1 SUB LP 0 GET LP 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT R X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 LP 0 GET X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND 'P' BIND X P 1 GET 1 ADD 1 X P 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: [ [ 1/2 0 ] ] [ 'X' BIND 'R' BIND R -1 GET 'LP' BIND R R LENGTH 1 SUB LP 0 GET LP 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT R X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 LP 0 GET X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET NIL T VALUES I GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.present_mean: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P 0 [ ADD ] FOLD P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'M' BIND FALSE 1 COLLECT M -1 DROP CONCAT 'PM' BIND M PM NOT AND [ TRUE AND ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 X SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
solutions.series.median: SORT 'S' BIND S S LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S S LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S S LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S S LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV 'MD' BIND V MD SUB 'DV' BIND DV DV -1 MUL MAX SORT 'S2' BIND S2 S2 LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S2 S2 LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: SORT TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.series.trimmed: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP 'T' BIND T 0 [ ADD ] FOLD T LENGTH DIV
